E1414

Devtools panel `{panel}` state field `{field}` has no publication

What

Devtools panel `{panel}` state field `{field}` has no publication

Why

Every panel state field must have a checked `core.devtools.publish` site

Fix

Publish `field: .{field}` with the field's declared type
